articles.title: India hosts military adventure event, 7 other nations participate
articles.summary: The Indian Army hosted a multi-national military adventure event in the Eastern Himalayas, with seven other nations participating. Held in Guwahati, this initiative promoted regional defence cooperation, camaraderie, and shared best practices in military skills and endurance. It showcased India's commitment to strengthening strategic partnerships and operational readiness among allied forces in challenging terrains, enhancing collective security and interoperability.

articles.title: Dream Cricket appoints Arpith Kanade as Head of Studio to drive global growth
articles.summary: Sports tech company Dream Sports has appointed Arpith Kanade as the Head of Studio for Dream Cricket. This rapidly expanding AAA mobile cricket game boasts over 25 million users and features more than 500 licensed elements, highlighting its significant presence in the mobile gaming market. Kanade's role will focus on leading the game's continued development and growth.

articles.title: Thailand, Cambodia dispute exchange of fire at border
articles.summary: Thailand's military reported exchanging fire with Cambodian forces along their border, accusing them of violating a December truce. This incident signals a renewed escalation in the long-standing territorial dispute. While Thailand claims its neighbour breached the ceasefire, Cambodia's capital, Phnom Penh, denied any use of weapons, highlighting ongoing tensions between the Southeast Asian nations.
